meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Recreate Order": "Create Order" with the values it opens with goes through

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary with one vendor bid.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before using its Settings menu.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: save the Recreate Order window without changing any values, confirm the window closes, and stop when the screen shows the new order creation result

steps.note: Use the buyer-side dialog with its opened defaults and submit it.
Verify Procol confirms that the new order was created.
